leave_sick_days_001.evidence: a. Those employed for one hundred eighty-three (183) days – 10 days... b. Those employed for one hundred eighty-four (184) days – 10 days... c. Those employed for two hundred and eight (208) days – 12 days

leave_sick_accrual_002.answer: Yes, it accumulates; cap is 1300 work hours.

leave_sick_family_003.evidence: Up to three (3) days of sick leave may be used by a teacher for each serious illness of a member of that teacher's immediate family

leave_personal_days_004.evidence: One (1) day of leave with pay each year is granted to an employee for personal matters

leave_personal_restrictions_005.answer: Requires special leave slip submission at least 3 days prior; not subject to principal approval except emergencies; reason need not be stated.
leave_personal_restrictions_005.evidence: Except in emergency situations, this leave is not subject to principal approval, however the employee must submit a special leave slip to his or her supervisor at least three (3) days prior to the date the leave will be taken. The teacher need not state the reason for taking leave under this section.

leave_personal_conversion_006.evidence: This leave may be accumulated up to five (5) days, including leave earned under Article 6, A.15.
